festivals.name: Son and Casino Dance Weekender
festivals.description: Weekend of Cuban social dance in Eugene, Oregon, taught by Amanda Gill and Adrian Valdivia (co-founders of DC Casineros). Workshops run as a single progression: son into casino, partnerwork foundations and rueda de casino, then double-handed moves, nudos, paseos and desplazamientos. For dancers who already have the basics. Friday son class and social with DJ Alejandro; Saturday son demo and social at WOW Hall. Main venue: The Vets Club. Nearest airport Portland.

festivals.name: Timba Flow Cuban Festival (TF MEX)
festivals.description: Four days on the Mexican Caribbean where one pass covers the hotel room (The Palm at Playa, central Playa del Carmen near Quinta Avenida), airport transfers, private beach access, workshops and a front-of-stage zone. Friday registration and welcome social; Saturday timba and son workshops plus open rumba (the only workshop day); Sunday live shows and outdoor colour party; Monday closing party on a catamaran. All-Cuban roster; built around music and the beach more than teaching.
